intent_contract.text: 이번엔 교실 틱톡 촬영 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘

A new scene with the same exceptionally beautiful fictional Korean senior student and attached appearance reference, now visibly recording a vertical TikTok dance video in her classroom rather than taking a selfie.

Create a candid vertical behind-the-scenes photograph of the same fictional 18-year-old Korean high-school senior shown in the attached reference image, inside a bright Korean classroom after class. She remains the universally admired standout beauty of the entire province, retaining the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, clear warm skin, large brown eyes, softly glossy pink lips, navy blazer, white shirt, and plaid ribbon bow. She records a vertical TikTok dance clip on a smartphone mounted to a compact desk tripod. Freeze her midway through a simple upbeat hand-dance between the desks, one hand marking the beat near her cheek and the other extending outward, meeting the phone camera with a confident playful smile. Use a vertical 9:16 behind-the-scenes frame from beside the recording phone; the phone and its live preview occupy the lower foreground while her three-quarter figure remains dominant. Add warm window light, a green chalkboard, scattered notebooks, believable phone-screen reflections, crisp facial detail, and natural classroom depth.
